title: tenant-audit census: shard the page and drop totals from prose so two PRs adding write sites stop conflicting (hot-file card B)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. On 2026-11-15 the maintainer chose 「今天改规则,并立全部 6 张卡」 on the hot-file serialization decision card (consequence as shown: 取消 protocol.ts 独占、关闭 #25467 和 #24586;卡 A 到 F 交各车道立卡,大 PR 和上限门禁仍逐个等您批准). Measurements: the hot-file analysis report (project artifact), re-runnable on request. Cross-lane rule (2026-11-15): no live seat in the owning lane, so `domain:server` seat 5 files and builds it; the owning lane is notified.

## Card B

The tenant-audit census page is a committed artifact every PR adding a write call site rewrites, and its prose carries totals, so two such PRs conflict.

- Shard the page (one file per package or per section) and remove totals from the prose (the gate prints them).
- Done when: two PRs that each add a write call site in different packages do not conflict on the census, shown by a merge-tree test or a scripted two-branch replay in the PR.
- Keep the census gate's semantics unchanged.
